title: Helmholzian spectra of graphs: basic properties
summary: The Helmholtzian matrix of a graph $G=(V(G),E(G))$ is a graph-theoretic analogue of the vector Laplacian (or Helmholtz operator) [S. Li, L. Lu, J.F. Wang, A graph discretization of vector Laplacian, 379 (2026) 446--460]. Motivated by the applications of graph Helmholtzian in simplicial networks, we will investiagte its basic spectral properties.
